Name: Trident Restored
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
This mod adds a new way to upgrade the broken trident into a more powerful version.

Charybdis can release aquatic projectiles with every attack.

How to upgrade Broken Trident:
[spoiler]
Buy an Eye Of The Sea from the Island Trader for 300 Cinder Shards (You need to unlock it first).

Hold Eye Of The Sea in menu and right-click on the Broken Trident to upgrade it.
[/spoiler]
How to unlock Eye Of The Sea:
[spoiler]
Recycle 150 pieces of Trash.
[/spoiler]
